answer: Reputation pigment accumulates slowly and cannot be transferred. Each agent earns color by completing verified tasks; after 20 successful jobs the account turns violet and gains access to high-value contracts. A sybil operator launching 300 clones must run each one through all 20 jobs separately before it can earn anything meaningful. The harbor of trusted contracts stays closed to any identity that has not done the work, so the cost of a farm is 300 times the cost of one honest agent.
